routes.name: Visa-free tourist entry
routes.summary: Citizens of most countries in the Americas and Europe, plus several in Asia and Oceania, enter Panama without a visa. The official list names who still needs one.

savings.note: minimum proof of funds, kids under 18 exempt

other: Passport valid at least 3 months
Confirmed return or onward ticket
Check the official nationality list for your passport

stay.note: Up to 3 months for most visa-free nationalities. US and Canadian citizens can get up to 180 days.

steps: Check your passport on the official visa list
Carry proof of funds and a return ticket
Fill out the arrival card from your airline

routes.name: Visa exemption for holders of US, Canada, EU, UK and similar visas
routes.summary: If your nationality normally needs a Panama visa, you can enter without one when you hold a valid visa or residence from certain countries.

other: Passport valid at least 3 months
Round-trip ticket
Rule comes from Executive Decree 521 as amended by Decree 196 of Oct 28, 2024
The embassy page shows two versions of the rule, so confirm before you fly

sources.label: Embassy of Panama in the US: Visas

routes.name: Authorized or stamped tourist visa
routes.summary: Nationals on the visa-required list apply at a Panamanian consulate. Some get an authorized visa and others a stamped visa.

other: Applies to nationalities that need a visa and do not qualify for the exemption
Proof of funds of at least US$500
Check the official list for your passport

stay.note: Length is set by the visa. Tourists can extend up to a total of 90 days.

steps: Apply at the Panamanian consulate with your documents
Wait for approval, then get the visa stamped if it is the stamped type
documents: Passport valid 3+ months beyond the trip
Hotel booking or invitation letter if relevant

fees.label: Second consulate fee (money order, US embassy)

routes.processing: Embassy page says up to 60 business days for authorized visas and up to 30 business days for stamped visas.

routes.name: Tourist stay extension
routes.summary: Tourists given less than 90 days can ask Migration to extend, up to a total of 90 days. Apply before the stay ends.

other: Approval by the Director General of Migration
Apply before the current stay expires

documents: Host sworn statement if staying with someone

sources.label: Migracion Panama: tourist visa extension requirements

routes.name: Transit rules
routes.summary: Nationals who need a visa can only transit Panama if they meet one of a short list of conditions. Passengers who stay inside the same migration facility skip the funds check.

other: Hold a valid Panama visa or residence, OR a valid residence or multiple-entry visa from the US, Canada, Australia, South Korea, UK, Singapore or the EU
OR be traveling to or from a country where you hold a valid visa or residence, or to your home country
Diplomats, officials and crew are also covered
Rules come from Resolutions 16024 and 24430 of 2023. Confirm before you fly

routes.name: Pensionado / jubilado residence (PE2)
routes.summary: For people with a lifetime pension of at least US$1,000 a month. The permit does not expire.

income.note: lifetime pension. Drops to US$750 if you own Panama property worth over US$100,000 in your name. Add US$250 a month per dependent.

other: Pension from a foreign government, international body or private company
Spouses can combine income to reach the minimum
Dependent children get a temporary permit until 25 while studying full time

steps: Gather documents and get them notarized or apostilled
Hire a lawyer to file with a power of attorney
documents: Notarized power of attorney and application form
Proof of extra income per dependent
Property registry certificate if you rely on the US$750 rule

routes.name: Residence by fixed-term bank deposit (PPT-SEP-DPF)
routes.summary: Put B/300,000 in a fixed-term deposit at a Panama bank for 3 years to get a 2 year provisional permit, then apply for permanent residence.

investment.note: fixed-term deposit in the applicant's name, funds from abroad, free of liens, held 3 years. Add B/2,000 per dependent.

other: Bank must hold a general license in Panama

stay.note: After 2 years you can apply for permanent residence.

documents: Notarized power of attorney and application
